name: Tania Te Hira
story: A LINZ geospatial student or graduate profile records Tania Te Hira: Geospatial Specialist, Haanuiorangi Te Whare Tapu o Ngāpuhi; formerly DOC Geospatial Information Analyst and Stats NZ.
GeoCart session 1 programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society (archived programme page) lists Tania Te Hira as an author of “Ngā Poutama Matawhenua Māori GIS Wānanga”.
